slides.title: Montana 7 North of Baker
slides.desc: Most people drive about 80 mph; pickup trucks outnumber cars 4:1.

slides.title: Abandoned gas station/store in Plevna, Montana
Train Station in Beach, North Dakota
slides.desc: The trains are very active in this part of the country, but tend to haul great quantities of a single homogenous cargo such as gas or grain. One train we passed had over 100 grain cars - each car exactly the same.

slides.title: Wide-load Hay Hauling on US 85 South of Williston
slides.desc: Wide-load trucks and heavy agricultural equipment are common on these roads; one harvester we passed had to move into the ditch for every oncoming vehicle.

slides.title: Tornado Siren in Beach, North Dakota
slides.desc: It sounds a test every day at 12 noon; even a block away, the noise was ear-splitting.
